caption: : Avg. performance across 11 datasets (y-axis) consistently improves as the number of training examples increases (x-axis). Max is 29k examples, the full size of our dataset.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the variation in average performance with respect to the number of training dataset examples. The x-axis, labeled “# of training dataset (k)”, is linear, ranging from 5 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Average Performance,” is linear, ranging from 48 to 56, with tick labels at intervals of 2. A single solid black line with circular markers is present, starting at a value of approximately 51.3 at x = 5 and increasing to approximately 55.8 at x = 30.
